ns2:Work.dc:title: Box - PayasRobot
ns2:Work.dc:description:
Reference-style robot bank: six finger-jointed faces, rear service door, arms and feet.
Created with Boxes.py (https://boxes.hackerspace-bamberg.de/) Command line: boxes PayasRobot --x=120 --y=100 --h=180 --thickness=3 --burn=0.15 --labels=0 Command line short: boxes PayasRobot
